summary: Drain in-flight iOS sidebar journal storage before allowing connection-host replacement.

replay.detail: Closing a host drops late storage results without changing durable edit lifecycle state.

compatibility.detail: The unwired host close method now returns a Promise. Owners must await close before constructing a replacement host for the same scope, including after deadline cancellation.

recovery.detail: Pending, completion and removal writes settle before a replacement can own the shared scoped record.
